qa.overall_assessment: The refactor is structurally correct and 4 of 5 acceptance criteria pass. However AC3 (HTML generator uses timeline for time display) fails with a critical bug: the two new helper methods _get_meal_time_from_timeline() and _get_timeline_time() were added to generate-html-interactive.py but are never called. All five old poi.get('time') call sites (lines 621, 706, 749, 807, 880) remain in _merge_day_data(). Since time was correctly stripped from POI files, all meal/attraction/entertainment/shopping/accommodation time fields in the generated HTML are null. Day 5 verification confirms: 谭豆花 (11:15), 明婷小馆 (13:00), and 饕林 (18:30) all show "time": null in the output HTML instead of the correct timeline times. The fix is a one-line substitution at each of the five call sites.

root_cause_verification.rationale: The root cause (dual authority over scheduling data) is structurally addressed: schemas are clean, data files are migrated, sync no longer injects time, validation no longer expects time. However the HTML generator fix is incomplete — the new timeline lookup methods were written but not wired into the calling code. The dual authority is eliminated from the data layer but the HTML output still shows null times because the lookup bridge was not connected.
